== Summary ==
Change crop (after) for [[Ominous Rumors (V)]]: the region (116, 876, 716, 1036) (x0, y0, x1, y1 in pixels) cut unchanged, without resizing, from the Players Committee card image of [[Ominous Rumors (V)]] (Original): [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/ominousrumors.gif Holotable commit efc26cd] (2024-12-29). The matching before crop is [[:File:V23-D-ominousrumors-2024-12-29-change-crop-before.png]]. Compared with the image of [[Ominous Rumors (V)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/335d47f6b929debedbac9376b863af4442469f36/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/ominousrumors.gif commit 335d47f]) and [[Ominous Rumors (V)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/ominousrumors.gif commit efc26cd]).
